      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Pinned release must carry signed provenance
        run: bash scripts/check_install_pin.sh

  quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-verify, install-pin-gate]
    if: always()
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

Senior Developer Engineer focused on code fixes You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| FIX_CI["Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup"] CI -->|No| THREADS FIX_CI --> THREADS[Address every open thread in pr_discussions.md] THREADS --> BLOCKING{BLOCKING issues?} BLOCKING -->|Yes| FIX_BLOCK["Fix BLOCKING first — security, critical bugs"] FIX_BLOCK --> IMPORTANT BLOCKING -->|No| IMPORTANT[Fix IMPORTANT issues] IMPORTANT --> SUGGESTIONS{Minor suggestions?} SUGGESTIONS -->|Yes| SKIP["Skip if time-consuming — note in response.md"] SUGGESTIONS -->|No| TEST["Follow TDD approach for every fix — see tdd_approach.md — then run tests and verify"] SKIP --> TEST TEST --> OUTPUT[Write outputs/response.md] OUTPUT --> REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue
— must fail before the fix

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. The upload-response compare keeps the precise per-file message with `sha256 nil != local` impossible: `nil` can no longer reach it.

## Scope note

The post-commit gate `verify_committed!` (a second, independent read after commit) still folds nil shas into its count-based drift message. It never claims 'stored different bytes' for nil, and the pre-commit gate now absorbs the transcoding window before any commit lands, so it was left as-is.

## Verification (local, plain ruby — stock system ruby 2.6.10, no flutter needed)

- `ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` → **25 checks passed**, including 5 new gh-1328 blocks:
  - unit: nil → missing-entry → verified across scripted reads (delayed listing goes green, never-again #3);
  - unit: foreign sha and reordered-but-complete sets classify as `remote sha mismatch` (never retried away);
  - unit: still-unreadable after N attempts → nil verdict;
  - end-to-end: fake Play omitting the upload sha + materializing on the 3rd list read **commits and verifies green**;
  - end-to-end: fake Play never materializing → abort naming `remote unreadable after 2 attempts`, message does NOT contain 'stored different bytes', no commit;
  - existing stored-bytes-mismatch block updated to pin the new `remote sha mismatch` class line — still aborts before commit.
- Failing-first: the new blocks were run against the unfixed module (red on the class-line assertion + old nil-mismatch path) before the fix, green after.
- All 20 pre-existing checks (#947 clear/verify semantics, #1261 REST-path/enum/readability/retry contracts) pass unchanged.
- `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart` does not pin either touched file (it pins Fastfile strings + appstore_preflight scenarios); Fastfile call site untouched (new kwargs default). Dart suite not run locally per fleet toolchain policy — the PR CI is the gate for it.

Fixes #1328

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unreadable route keys on `nil` only — an empty-string sha would still raise the byte-mismatch class**

The gate into `poll_stored_sha!` is `if stored.nil?`, and `upload_image!` returns
`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while
the new bytes process — instead of a nil entry — then
`readable.any? { |sha| !expected_prefix.include?(sha) }` fires `remote sha mismatch` and
aborts a perfectly healthy upload: a residual false-mismatch path of exactly the class
this PR eliminates, scoped to single-slot replaces.

Unproven (the incident showed `sha256: nil`, and historic single-slot uploads returned
shas — the current code is policy-conformant with the issue's "foreign sha → mismatch"
table), so suggestion only: either note the assumption in the gh-1328 comment block, or —
if a daily leg ever reds this way — treat `readable == [previous sha]` for single-slot
types as "unreadable" rather than mismatch.

### Thread 3 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: comment math — the window is (attempts − 1) × backoff, not attempts × backoff**

The comment says "poll edits.images.list across the processing window
(attempts × backoff seconds)", but the loop skips the sleep after the final attempt
(`sleep(backoff) if attempt < attempts - 1`), so the actual window is
**(attempts − 1) × backoff ≈ 120 s** at the 5×30 defaults (plus 5 list round-trips),

#   … poll edits.images.list across the processing window
#   ((attempts - 1) sleeps of `backoff` between `attempts` reads) …

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):

The new unit pins cover materialize→verified, foreign sha→mismatch, complete
reorder→mismatch, and all-nil→unreadable. Not pinned is the remaining deliberate branch:

```

  quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-verify, install-pin-gate]
    if: always()
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"

          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. The upload-response compare keeps the precise per-file message with `sha256 nil != local` impossible: `nil` can no longer reach it.

## Scope note

The post-commit gate `verify_committed!` (a second, independent read after commit) still folds nil shas into its count-based drift message. It never claims 'stored different bytes' for nil, and the pre-commit gate now absorbs the transcoding window before any commit lands, so it was left as-is.

## Verification (local, plain ruby — stock system ruby 2.6.10, no flutter needed)

- `ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` → **25 checks passed**, including 5 new gh-1328 blocks:
  - unit: nil → missing-entry → verified across scripted reads (delayed listing goes green, never-again #3);
  - unit: foreign sha and reordered-but-complete sets classify as `remote sha mismatch` (never retried away);
  - unit: still-unreadable after N attempts → nil verdict;
  - end-to-end: fake Play omitting the upload sha + materializing on the 3rd list read **commits and verifies green**;
  - end-to-end: fake Play never materializing → abort naming `remote unreadable after 2 attempts`, message does NOT contain 'stored different bytes', no commit;
  - existing stored-bytes-mismatch block updated to pin the new `remote sha mismatch` class line — still aborts before commit.
- Failing-first: the new blocks were run against the unfixed module (red on the class-line assertion + old nil-mismatch path) before the fix, green after.
- All 20 pre-existing checks (#947 clear/verify semantics, #1261 REST-path/enum/readability/retry contracts) pass unchanged.
- `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart` does not pin either touched file (it pins Fastfile strings + appstore_preflight scenarios); Fastfile call site untouched (new kwargs default). Dart suite not run locally per fleet toolchain policy — the PR CI is the gate for it.

Fixes #1328

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1329._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unreadable route keys on `nil` only — an empty-string sha would still raise the byte-mismatch class**

The gate into `poll_stored_sha!` is `if stored.nil?`, and `upload_image!` returns
`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while

          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. ## Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

blocks.text:
permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Pinned release must carry signed provenance
        run: bash scripts/check_install_pin.sh

  quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-verify, install-pin-gate]
    if: always()
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. The upload-response compare keeps the precise per-file message with `sha256 nil != local` impossible: `nil` can no longer reach it.

## Scope note

The post-commit gate `verify_committed!` (a second, independent read after commit) still folds nil shas into its count-based drift message. It never claims 'stored different bytes' for nil, and the pre-commit gate now absorbs the transcoding window before any commit lands, so it was left as-is.

## Verification (local, plain ruby — stock system ruby 2.6.10, no flutter needed)

- `ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` → **25 checks passed**, including 5 new gh-1328 blocks:
  - unit: nil → missing-entry → verified across scripted reads (delayed listing goes green, never-again #3);
  - unit: foreign sha and reordered-but-complete sets classify as `remote sha mismatch` (never retried away);
  - unit: still-unreadable after N attempts → nil verdict;
  - end-to-end: fake Play omitting the upload sha + materializing on the 3rd list read **commits and verifies green**;
  - end-to-end: fake Play never materializing → abort naming `remote unreadable after 2 attempts`, message does NOT contain 'stored different bytes', no commit;
  - existing stored-bytes-mismatch block updated to pin the new `remote sha mismatch` class line — still aborts before commit.
- Failing-first: the new blocks were run against the unfixed module (red on the class-line assertion + old nil-mismatch path) before the fix, green after.
- All 20 pre-existing checks (#947 clear/verify semantics, #1261 REST-path/enum/readability/retry contracts) pass unchanged.
- `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart` does not pin either touched file (it pins Fastfile strings + appstore_preflight scenarios); Fastfile call site untouched (new kwargs default). Dart suite not run locally per fleet toolchain policy — the PR CI is the gate for it.

Fixes #1328

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1329._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unreadable route keys on `nil` only — an empty-string sha would still raise the byte-mismatch class**

The gate into `poll_stored_sha!` is `if stored.nil?`, and `upload_image!` returns
`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while
the new bytes process — instead of a nil entry — then
`readable.any? { |sha| !expected_prefix.include?(sha) }` fires `remote sha mismatch` and
aborts a perfectly healthy upload: a residual false-mismatch path of exactly the class
this PR eliminates, scoped to single-slot replaces.

Unproven (the incident showed `sha256: nil`, and historic single-slot uploads returned
shas — the current code is policy-conformant with the issue's "foreign sha → mismatch"
table), so suggestion only: either note the assumption in the gh-1328 comment block, or —
if a daily leg ever reds this way — treat `readable == [previous sha]` for single-slot
types as "unreadable" rather than mismatch.

---

### Thread 3 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: comment math — the window is (attempts − 1) × backoff, not attempts × backoff**

The comment says "poll edits.images.list across the processing window
(attempts × backoff seconds)", but the loop skips the sleep after the final attempt
(`sleep(backoff) if attempt < attempts - 1`), so the actual window is
**(attempts − 1) × backoff ≈ 120 s** at the 5×30 defaults (plus 5 list round-trips),
not 150 s. One-word doc accuracy, nothing more:

```ruby
#   … poll edits.images.list across the processing window
#   ((attempts - 1) sleeps of `backoff` between `attempts` reads) …
```

---

### Thread 4 — `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: pin the conservative "partial set in wrong order → retry → unreadable" corner**

The new unit pins cover materialize→verified, foreign sha→mismatch, complete
reorder→mismatch, and all-nil→unreadable. Not pinned is the remaining deliberate branch:
a **partial** readable set in the wrong order (expected `[sha1, sha2]`, readable
`[sha2]`) — `sha2` is known and `readable.size < expected.size`, so the poll retries and,
if it never resolves inside the window, lands on the `remote unreadable` verdict. Nothing
guards that choice; a future refactor that reclassifies it as a mismatch (or as a
prefix-match) would ship untested.

One scripted case next to the all-nil block would pin it:

```ruby
poll = PollHttp.new([[{ "sha256" => sha2 }]] * 3)
verdict = PlayListingSync.poll_stored_sha!(poll, "dev.fa1.app", "edit1", "en-US",
                                           "phoneScreenshots", [sha1, sha2], poll_auth,
                                           attempts: 3, backoff: 0)
raise "FAIL: partial out-of-order set must stay in the retry window" unless verdict.nil?
```

Related nano-nit: this is the only corner where the caller's "Play never returned a
usable sha256 for the just-uploaded image" phrasing is slightly off — the just-uploaded
`sha2` *was* readable; `sha1` wasn't. Not worth chasing.

          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)

          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}

          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}

          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch

                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):

`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while
the new bytes process — instead of a nil entry — then
`readable.any? { |sha| !expected_prefix.include?(sha) }` fires `remote sha mismatch` and
aborts a perfectly healthy upload: a residual false-mismatch path of exactly the class
this PR eliminates, scoped to single-slot replaces.

shas — the current code is policy-conformant with the issue's "foreign sha → mismatch"
table), so suggestion only: either note the assumption in the gh-1328 comment block, or —

### Thread 3 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: comment math — the window is (attempts − 1) × backoff, not attempts × backoff**

The comment says "poll edits.images.list across the processing window

permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Pinned release must carry signed provenance
        run: bash scripts/check_install_pin.sh

  quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-verify, install-pin-gate]
    if: always()
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. The upload-response compare keeps the precise per-file message with `sha256 nil != local` impossible: `nil` can no longer reach it.

## Scope note

The post-commit gate `verify_committed!` (a second, independent read after commit) still folds nil shas into its count-based drift message. It never claims 'stored different bytes' for nil, and the pre-commit gate now absorbs the transcoding window before any commit lands, so it was left as-is.

## Verification (local, plain ruby — stock system ruby 2.6.10, no flutter needed)

- `ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` → **25 checks passed**, including 5 new gh-1328 blocks:
  - unit: nil → missing-entry → verified across scripted reads (delayed listing goes green, never-again #3);
  - unit: foreign sha and reordered-but-complete sets classify as `remote sha mismatch` (never retried away);
  - unit: still-unreadable after N attempts → nil verdict;
  - end-to-end: fake Play omitting the upload sha + materializing on the 3rd list read **commits and verifies green**;
  - end-to-end: fake Play never materializing → abort naming `remote unreadable after 2 attempts`, message does NOT contain 'stored different bytes', no commit;
  - existing stored-bytes-mismatch block updated to pin the new `remote sha mismatch` class line — still aborts before commit.
- Failing-first: the new blocks were run against the unfixed module (red on the class-line assertion + old nil-mismatch path) before the fix, green after.
- All 20 pre-existing checks (#947 clear/verify semantics, #1261 REST-path/enum/readability/retry contracts) pass unchanged.
- `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart` does not pin either touched file (it pins Fastfile strings + appstore_preflight scenarios); Fastfile call site untouched (new kwargs default). Dart suite not run locally per fleet toolchain policy — the PR CI is the gate for it.

Fixes #1328

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1329._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unreadable route keys on `nil` only — an empty-string sha would still raise the byte-mismatch class**

The gate into `poll_stored_sha!` is `if stored.nil?`, and `upload_image!` returns
`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while
the new bytes process — instead of a nil entry — then
`readable.any? { |sha| !expected_prefix.include?(sha) }` fires `remote sha mismatch` and

          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || fail "changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || fail "supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || fail "dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          # The remaining legs are path-gated (flutter-analyze covers the
          # lib/bin/test surface; the build-* legs cover platform targets):
          # success or skipped is fine, anything else fails. Branch
          # protection relies on THIS aggregate as the single required
          # check (AGENTS.md "one aggregate Quality gate"), so every needs
          # leg must land here — a red platform build must never yield a
          # green required check.
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
            if [ "$r" != "success" ] && [ "$r" != "skipped" ]; then
              fail "a leg is $r ($name)"
            fi
          done
          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1329
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1329
- **Title**: fix(1328): Play listing verify — unreadable remote sha retried + classified, never a false byte mismatch
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1328-play-sha-nil-verify` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +167
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T17:43:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T01:38:36Z

## PR Description

## Root cause

Daily-publish Play leg red (run 37495698362): `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb` compared the sha256 returned by `edits.images.upload` against the local golden and raised `Play stored different bytes … (sha256 nil != local …)`. Play had answered the upload **HTTP 200 without a usable `sha256`** (image still processing / transcoding window), so `JSON.parse(body)["sha256"]` came back `nil` — and `nil != local` fell into the mismatch branch. **An UNREADABLE remote object was treated as a MISMATCHED one; the bytes were never compared.** The guard's abort-before-commit semantics were never at fault — only the classification was.

## Fix — unreadable ≠ mismatch (policy per the issue body)

`nil` stored sha now routes to a new `poll_stored_sha!`: poll `edits.images.list` across the processing window (**5 attempts × 30 s**, tunable via `sha_attempts:`/`sha_backoff:` kwargs — defaults keep the Fastfile call site unchanged), then classify:

| remote state after window | verdict |
|---|---|
| readable set equals goldens uploaded so far | **verified → proceed** (issue AC1: green within the retry window) |
| readable bytes contradict the goldens (foreign sha, or complete set in wrong order) | **`remote sha mismatch`** raise — abort-before-commit semantics unchanged (AC2) |
| entries missing / shas still nil | **`remote unreadable after N attempts`** raise — a DISTINCT class, never a fake mismatch |

Both failure log lines name their class (`remote sha mismatch` vs `remote unreadable after N attempts`, AC3) and the retry loop warns per attempt (`remote unreadable for <locale>/<type> (attempt i/N …)`), so triage is one grep. The upload-response compare keeps the precise per-file message with `sha256 nil != local` impossible: `nil` can no longer reach it.

## Scope note

The post-commit gate `verify_committed!` (a second, independent read after commit) still folds nil shas into its count-based drift message. It never claims 'stored different bytes' for nil, and the pre-commit gate now absorbs the transcoding window before any commit lands, so it was left as-is.

## Verification (local, plain ruby — stock system ruby 2.6.10, no flutter needed)

- `ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` → **25 checks passed**, including 5 new gh-1328 blocks:
  - unit: nil → missing-entry → verified across scripted reads (delayed listing goes green, never-again #3);
  - unit: foreign sha and reordered-but-complete sets classify as `remote sha mismatch` (never retried away);
  - unit: still-unreadable after N attempts → nil verdict;
  - end-to-end: fake Play omitting the upload sha + materializing on the 3rd list read **commits and verifies green**;
  - end-to-end: fake Play never materializing → abort naming `remote unreadable after 2 attempts`, message does NOT contain 'stored different bytes', no commit;
  - existing stored-bytes-mismatch block updated to pin the new `remote sha mismatch` class line — still aborts before commit.
- Failing-first: the new blocks were run against the unfixed module (red on the class-line assertion + old nil-mismatch path) before the fix, green after.
- All 20 pre-existing checks (#947 clear/verify semantics, #1261 REST-path/enum/readability/retry contracts) pass unchanged.
- `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart` does not pin either touched file (it pins Fastfile strings + appstore_preflight scenarios); Fastfile call site untouched (new kwargs default). Dart suite not run locally per fleet toolchain policy — the PR CI is the gate for it.

Fixes #1328

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unreadable route keys on `nil` only — an empty-string sha would still raise the byte-mismatch class**

The gate into `poll_stored_sha!` is `if stored.nil?`, and `upload_image!` returns
`JSON.parse(res[:body])["sha256"]`. The observed incident is omission (no field → `nil`),
but a hypothetical `"sha256": ""` payload would fall through to the mismatch raise —
`remote sha mismatch: … (sha256 "" != local 662be4…)` — i.e. the exact false-mismatch
class gh-1328 removes, arriving via a different payload shape.

Cheap hardening in the same spirit as the `.compact` on the list-read side:

```ruby
if stored.to_s.strip.empty?   # nil or "" → UNREADABLE, never a byte mismatch
```

Not proven to occur; fine to defer to a follow-up.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: single-slot replaces (icon/featureGraphic) depend on Play serving a *nil* entry — not the old sha — during the processing window**

For multi-slot sets this fix is airtight: `clear_plan` empties the set first, so during
the transcoding window the list can only contain missing entries or `sha256: nil` → both
classify as "retry". For the **single-slot** types there is no clear (deliberately —
console-only locales keep their icon/featureGraphic), so the previous image's sha exists
on the listing until the replacement lands. If Play ever surfaces the **old** sha while
the new bytes process — instead of a nil entry — then
`readable.any? { |sha| !expected_prefix.include?(sha) }` fires `remote sha mismatch` and
aborts a perfectly healthy upload: a residual false-mismatch path of exactly the class
this PR eliminates, scoped to single-slot replaces.

Unproven (the incident showed `sha256: nil`, and historic single-slot uploads returned
shas — the current code is policy-conformant with the issue's "foreign sha → mismatch"
table), so suggestion only: either note the assumption in the gh-1328 comment block, or —
if a daily leg ever reds this way — treat `readable == [previous sha]` for single-slot
types as "unreadable" rather than mismatch.

---

### Thread 3 — `flutter_app/fastlane/play_listing_sync.rb`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-06):
💡 **SUGGESTION: comment math — the window is (attempts − 1) × backoff, not attempts × backoff**

The comment says "poll edits.images.list across the processing window
(attempts × backoff seconds)", but the loop skips the sleep after the final attempt
(`sleep(backoff) if attempt < attempts - 1`), so the actual window is
**(attempts − 1) × backoff ≈ 120 s** at the 5×30 defaults (plus 5 list round-trips),
not 150 s. One-word doc accuracy, nothing more:

```ruby
#   … poll edits.images.list across the processing window
#   ((attempts - 1) sleeps of `backoff` between `attempts` reads) …
```
